inputs.text: [excited] It was 15 meters long — as long as a school bus! [quickly] Standing up, it was 4 meters tall — as tall as a double-decker bus! And it weighed 7,000 kilos — [amazed] as heavy as an elephant and a rhino put together!
[serious] Longer, yes. But thinner. [calm] And they never even met — two different continents.
